/* CSS Reset and Base Styles */
* {

:root {

/* Section Titles */

.section-subtitle {

/* Hero Section */
.hero {

            // Use IntersectionObserver instead of scroll events for better performance

            // Create observers for different element types
            function setupAnimationObservers() {
                // Simple fade in animation via CSS class
                function animateElement(element, delay = 0) {
                    if (element.classList.contains('animated')) return;

                    element.classList.add('animated');

                    // Use classes instead of inline styles for better performance
                    element.classList.add('animate-prepare');

                    setTimeout(() => {
                        element.classList.add('animate-in');

                    entries.forEach((entry) => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const metricValue = entry.target;
                            if (metricValue.classList.contains('animated')) return;

                            metricValue.classList.add('animated');

                            // Get the target value and animate counting up
                            const targetValue = metricValue.textContent;
                            let isPercentage = targetValue.includes('%');
                            let multiplier = targetValue.includes('x');
                            let value = parseInt(targetValue);

                            if (!isNaN(value)) {
                                // Start from 0
                                metricValue.textContent = '0' + (isPercentage ? '%' : (multiplier ? 'x' : ''));

                                // Use requestAnimationFrame for smoother animation
                                let startTime = null;
                                const duration = 1500; // Reduced from 2000ms

                                function animateCounter(timestamp) {
                                    if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
                                    const progress = Math.min((timestamp - startTime) / duration, 1);
                                    const currentValue = Math.floor(value * progress);

                                    metricValue.textContent = currentValue + (isPercentage ? '%' : (multiplier ? 'x' : ''));

                                    if (progress < 1) {
                                        requestAnimationFrame(animateCounter);
                                    }
                                }

                                requestAnimationFrame(animateCounter);
                            }

                            metricObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
                        }
                    });
                }, observerOptions);

                const supportLevelEl = document.querySelector('.pricing-card.popular .support-level');

                if (userCountEl) {
                    userCountEl.textContent = isAnnual ? 'Jusqu\'à 5 utilisateurs' : 'Jusqu\'à 3 utilisateurs';
                }

                if (supportLevelEl) {
                    supportLevelEl.textContent = isAnnual ? 'Support premium' : 'Support de base';
                }

                // Update pricing for each card
                pricingCards.forEach((card, index) => {
                    if (index > 2) return; // Skip if more than 3 cards (safety check)

                    const priceEl = card.querySelector('.pricing-price');
                    const periodEl = card.querySelector('.pricing-period');
                    const monthlyEl = card.querySelector('.pricing-monthly');

                    if (priceEl && periodEl && monthlyEl) {
                        if (isAnnual) {
                            priceEl.textContent = annualPrices[index];
                            monthlyEl.textContent = annualText[index];
                        } else {
                            priceEl.textContent = monthlyPrices[index];
                            monthlyEl.textContent = monthlyText[index];
                        }

                        // Only show period for non-enterprise plans
                        if (index < 2) {
                            periodEl.textContent = pricePeriod;
                            periodEl.style.display = '';
                        } else {
                            periodEl.style.display = 'none';
                        }
                    }
                });
            }

            // Set toggle to checked (annual) by default
            pricingToggle.checked = true;

            // Apply annual pricing on page load
            updatePricing();

            // Add event listener for toggle changes
            pricingToggle.addEventListener('change', function () {
                updatePricing();
            });

        });


        // Google Analytics Event Tracking
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            // Track hero button clicks
            const heroButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-buttons .btn');
            heroButtons.forEach(button => {
                button.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    const isOutline = this.classList.contains('btn-outline');
                    gtag('event', isOutline ? 'view_features_click' : 'discover_offers_click', {
                        'event_category': isOutline ? 'engagement' : 'lead_generation',
                        'button_location': 'hero_section'
                    });
                });
            });

            // Track tab interactions
            const heroTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-tab');
            heroTabs.forEach(tab => {
                tab.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    const tabName = this.textContent.trim();
                    gtag('event', 'view_product_demo', {
                        'event_category': 'engagement',
                        'demo_type': tabName
                    });
                });
            });

            // Track feature card interactions
            const featureCards = document.querySelectorAll('.feature-card');
            featureCards.forEach(card => {
                card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
                    const featureTitle = this.querySelector('.feature-title').textContent.trim();
                    gtag('event', 'feature_hover', {
                        'event_category': 'engagement',
                        'feature_name': featureTitle
                    });
                });
            });

            // Track client logo interactions
            const clientLogos = document.querySelectorAll('.client-logo');
            clientLogos.forEach(logo => {
                logo.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
                    const clientName = this.getAttribute('alt');
                    gtag('event', 'client_logo_hover', {
                        'event_category': 'engagement',
                        'client_name': clientName
                    });
                });
            });

            // Track pricing plan selection
            const pricingButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.pricing-card .btn');
            pricingButtons.forEach(button => {
                button.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    const planTitle = this.closest('.pricing-card').querySelector('.pricing-title').textContent.trim();
                    const isAnnual = document.getElementById('pricing-toggle').checked;
                    gtag('event', 'select_plan', {
                        'event_category': 'conversion',
                        'plan_type': planTitle,
                        'billing_cycle': isAnnual ? 'annual' : 'monthly'
                    });
                });
            });

            // Track pricing toggle
            const pricingToggle = document.getElementById('pricing-toggle');
            if (pricingToggle) {
                pricingToggle.addEventListener('change', function () {
                    gtag('event', 'toggle_pricing', {
                        'event_category': 'engagement',
                        'billing_cycle': this.checked ? 'annual' : 'monthly'
                    });
                });
            }

            // Track testimonial interactions
            const testimonials = document.querySelectorAll('.glass-card');
            testimonials.forEach(testimonial => {
                testimonial.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
                    const authorName = this.querySelector('footer div:first-child').textContent.trim();
                    gtag('event', 'testimonial_hover', {
                        'event_category': 'engagement',
                        'testimonial_author': authorName
                    });
                });
            });

            // Track scroll depth
            let scrollMarkers = [25, 50, 75, 100];
            let scrolledMarkers = [];

            window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
                const scrollPercent = Math.round((window.scrollY / (document.body.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight)) * 100);

                scrollMarkers.forEach(marker => {
                    if (scrollPercent >= marker && !scrolledMarkers.includes(marker)) {
                        scrolledMarkers.push(marker);
                        gtag('event', 'scroll_depth', {
                            'event_category': 'engagement',
                            'percent': marker + '%'
                        });
                    }
                });
            });
        });

    
    </script>
